_comment: Single-slot sample for SA8775P: Qwen3-4B-Instruct on the default NSP. Copy next to genie-server.py as env_config.json and adjust paths. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the server.
_comment_poll: POLL:false turns off the HTP backend's busy-wait (measured on SA8255P: ~260% CPU for no latency gain). Remove it to keep whatever the model bundle sets.
_comment_slot: model_root is the only key a slot needs; name defaults to slot0 and an unset device_id means the model's own HTP config decides which core it lands on. A relative model_root resolves under MODELS_BASE_DIR, the same way POST /v1/models/switch resolves model_dir; write it absolute to load a model from outside that directory.
_prompt_logprobs: set PROMPT_LOGPROBS: true to allow lm_eval loglikelihood scoring from startup (or toggle at runtime via POST /v1/server/prompt_logprobs)
